title: Interactive absorption
description: The identities a surviving commit took in through an interactive `squash` or `fixup` (shared-portable note record; src/rebase-operations.js recordSuccessfulApplication). It reuses the landing absorption model of ADR-0003: coverage for an absorbed change comes from this record, exactly as it does from a landing. The absorbed identities appear here and nowhere else — the surviving commit carries exactly one Change-Id, its own, because several trailers on one commit would make the surviving identity depend on parse order (ADR-0035).

action.description: Identity handling is the same for both. They differ only in the absorbed prose: `squash` keeps it under the surviving message, `fixup` discards it.

survivingCommit.description: The commit that survives and that this record is attached to.

survivingChangeId.description: The surviving identity, which is the target's. It never appears in absorbedChanges.
